login.title: Welcome to Pain Therapy
login.text: This application is for Ayanta staff. Sign in with your Ayanta account.
login.note: Sign-in uses Ayanta Entra ID. Personal Microsoft accounts and guest accounts get no access.
login.expired: Your session ended after 30 minutes without activity. Please sign in again.
login.devNote: Local only. In production, sign-in works exclusively through Entra ID.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.foreign: This account does not belong to Ayanta. Personal Microsoft accounts, guest accounts and accounts of other organisations have no access.
noAccess.noRole: Your Ayanta account has no role for this application.
noAccess.help: Ask the administration to assign you the "Therapist" or "Administration" role in Entra ID.
noAccess.forbidden: You do not have permission for this page.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivate.text: The record disappears from the default list. All data and signed documents are kept, and you can reactivate the record at any time. Deleting is not possible.

reauth.title: Leave patient mode
reauth.text: Sign in again with your Ayanta account to return to the practice view.
reauth.aborted: Signing was not completed. The disclaimer stays "not signed" in the record.

done.title: Disclaimer signed
done.text: {name} signed on {at}. The PDF is archived in the record and cannot be changed.
done.checkNote: Please check and correct the personal details in the record.
done.abortedText: The disclaimer of {name} stays "not signed" in the record.

signing.intro: Hello {name}. Please check your details, read the text to the end and then sign.
signing.noteLabel: Is something wrong? Note it here.
signing.readHint: Please read the text to the end. You can sign after that.
signing.consentLiability: I have read the liability waiver and agree to it.
signing.consentData: I consent to the processing of my personal and health data as described in the privacy notice.
signing.consentEmail: The practice may send me documents and appointment information by unencrypted email.
signing.consentRequiredError: Unfortunately, treatment is not possible without this consent.
signing.signatureHint: Sign here with your finger or Apple Pencil
signing.signatureLocked: Please read the text to the end first
signing.submitError: The signature could not be saved. Please hand the device back to your therapist.
signing.readError: Please read the text to the end first.
signing.name: Name
signing.thanksText: Your signature has been saved. Please hand the device back to your therapist now.
signing.thanksMail: You will receive the signed document by email at {email}.
signing.thanksNoMail: You can get a printed copy of the document on request.

email.subject: Your signed liability waiver ({number})
email.body:
Hello {name}

Attached is the liability waiver with patient information and privacy notice that you signed on {date}.

Kind regards
Your pain therapy team

handoutEmail.bodyWithLink:
Dear {name}

Please find attached your personal exercise sheet from the consultation on {date}.

In the patient zone you can record when you did the exercises and how well they went:
{url}

When you first open it on a device, please confirm with your date of birth. Please do not pass the link on.

Kind regards
Your pain therapy team

This email is not encrypted. You agreed to receive unencrypted email and can withdraw this consent at any time.

accessLinkEmail.subject: Your access to the patient zone
accessLinkEmail.body:
Dear {name}

With this personal link you record when you did your exercises and how well they went:
{url}

When you first open it on a device, please confirm with your date of birth. The link is valid until {date} while your home programme runs. Please do not pass it on; an earlier link no longer works.

Kind regards
Your pain therapy team

This email is not encrypted. You agreed to receive unencrypted email and can withdraw this consent at any time.

accessSheet.title: Your access to the patient zone
accessSheet.intro: For {name}: here you record when you did your exercises and how well they went.
accessSheet.step1: Scan the QR code with your phone camera or type the address into the browser.
accessSheet.step2: Confirm with your date of birth. The device then stays signed in for 30 days.
accessSheet.step3: After each exercise record whether you did it and how well you could do it (1 to 10).
accessSheet.validity: Valid until {date} while your home programme runs.
accessSheet.keep: Please keep this sheet safe and do not pass it on. A new access sheet replaces this one.
accessSheet.footer: Only your therapist and the practice see your entries. Questions: pain-therapy@ayanta.ch
accessSheet.introSign: For {name}: please read and sign the liability waiver with patient information and privacy notice on your phone.
accessSheet.step3Sign: Read the text to the end, confirm the consents and sign with your finger. This takes about 5 minutes.
accessSheet.validitySign: Valid until {date} while your signature is pending or your home programme runs.
